frames.step_name: Hang the cone from the branch
frames.visible_job: Draws one slanted branch with one left nub, a short connecting stem, and one plump tapered pinecone silhouette beneath it.
frames.instruction: Draw one slightly broken branch from upper left toward upper right, keeping one short cut nub on its left half. From the branch middle, drop one short stem and wrap a plump egg-shaped pinecone around it, narrowing the lower end to a soft point.
adds: slanted pine branch and left nub
introduces: slanted pine branch and left nub

frames.visible_job: Adds a center column and two neighboring rows of broad scale shapes inside the fixed silhouette.
frames.instruction: Begin near the top center and stack broad U-shaped scales downward, overlapping each new row beneath the one above. Add one neighboring row on each side while keeping every scale inside the cone outline.

frames.visible_job: Extends the overlapping scale rhythm to both outer edges and into the pointed base.
frames.instruction: Continue the curved scale rows out toward both cone edges. Make the side scales narrower and angle the lowest rows inward so the pattern closes neatly at the established bottom point.

frames.visible_job: Adds exactly three attached needle clusters and one upper-right nub around the unchanged cone.
frames.instruction: Attach exactly three pine-needle clusters to the branch: one at the left end, one above the cone stem, and one at the right end. Add one short upper-right twig nub, keeping the earlier left nub and rooting every needle stroke visibly at its cluster base.

frames.visible_job: Adds shadow beneath selected scale lips, one broken shadow below the cone, and two reserved highlights.
frames.instruction: Darken just beneath selected scale lips so the overlaps read clearly, then place one soft broken shadow below the pinecone. Preserve exactly two small open-paper highlights across the upper scale rows.

final_step.visible_job: Layers restrained brown, green, and cool-gray pencil only over the established branch, cone, needles, and shadow.
final_step.instruction: Layer warm brown through the established cone and branch, muted pine green along the same three needle clusters, and cool gray in the existing broken shadow. Keep the graphite scale pattern and both paper highlights visible, and add no new contours.
adds: restrained woodland color on established forms
